title: The Runaway
summary: A donkey ran away from a master who gave him regular food and straw, seeking freedom in the mountains....
full_text:
A donkey ran away from a master who gave him regular food and straw, seeking freedom in the mountains.

He soon found the peaks barren of food, frozen with snow, and prowled by wolves, wishing bitterly for his old stall and warm manger.
moral: Rushing blindly to escape modest toil often leads into worse captivity.
